why: The handler that paints instead of persisting. The label moves under the finger, so it looks like it worked -- and nothing else does: the preference is not saved, `effectiveSettings` never republishes, and `hud.setReducedMotion` never fires, so the transitions the player is trying to change carry on exactly as before. That is issue #364's fifth criterion and the whole point of issue #289, and it is why the store is the only thing a settings handler is allowed to touch.
